latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: autonomous context recovery for AI agents. 6-step recovery flow (sessions_history → transcript → channel summary → cross-channel search → memory → ask user). Includes search script for cross-session keyword search. Handles compaction recovery, channel switches, cron-to-channel messages, and thread replies.
